profile.headline: Senior Frontend Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: I love creating mobile and desktop Web applications, supporting my frontend focus with backend and dev-ops experience.  I geek out over architectural design and love to apply what I learn in full-stack JavaScript.

positions.title: Frontend Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and developed websites in Dart frontend and Java backend
* Led scrum-style standups and planning for ~8 person team
* Managed oncall rotation and improved monitoring and release processes and documentation

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Specialize as front-end architect and subject-matter expert for Angular 1.x/Webpack/ES2015-based single-page application
•	Design, develop, and support a front-end core and library set shared between product teams
•	Develop and support Node.js-powered applications written in the Loopback (Express-based) framework using Node 6, ES2015, and Babel
•	Contribute to LoopBack's open-source community with non-confidential improvements necessary for the project
•	Prepare and present product demos for executive team on a bi-weekly basis
•	Help establish and maintain standards for code reviews, JavaScript linting, internationalization-ready HTML templates, and required unit test coverage
•	Support and extend API unit and end-to-end test suites using Mocha, Chai, Supertest, and Sinon

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented developer tools to simplify webapp analytics within company network.
•	Designed and executed native app testing for international development contractors.
•	Updated and maintained Bootstrap-based one-pager event websites for multiple company hackathons.
•	Helped organize and administrate internal hackathon for 200 interns.
•	Designed, developed, and supported CSS3-based responsive websites for Internet Explorer 9+, Chrome, Firefox, and Safari on Windows, Macintosh, Android, iOS, and Windows Phone.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Continued specialization in front-end development using JQuery, PHP, WordPress, and Bootstrap.
•	Led project to support and update web application for international offices using AngularJS.
•	Designed, developed, and supported CSS3-based responsive websites for Internet Explorer 7+, Chrome, Firefox, and Safari on Windows, Macintosh, Android, iOS, and Windows Phone.
•	Collaborated with designers in local and overseas teams to collect requirements and meet feature request deadlines.

positions.title: Interim Intern
positions.description:
•	Specialized in front-end development using JQuery, PHP, WordPress, and Bootstrap.
•	Designed, developed, and supported CSS3-based responsive website for Internet Explorer 7+, Chrome, Firefox, and Safari on Windows, Macintosh, Android, iOS, and Windows Phone.
•	Educated team on real-time website development using Meteor and MongoDB.
•	Helped organize and advertise internal hackathon for 100 interns.
•	Collaborated with designers in local and overseas teams to collect feature requirements and meet requested deadlines.
•	Recipient of two "Qualstar" employee awards for excellence in App Store development and contributions to the intern hackathon.

positions.title: Engineering Interim Intern
positions.description:
•	Specialized in algorithm and data structure design for Android.
•	Designed for a multithreaded, shared-data environment using the Lua scripting language.
•	Prepared design overviews and software demonstrations for customers.
•	Collaborated with a small development team using a prototype-driven methodology.

positions.title: Script Programming Contractor
positions.description:
•	Modified generated SQL scripts to fetch and present customized sales reports for external use.
•	Self-managed several script projects to meet client’s release priorities.
•	Self-taught SQL scripting language to prepare for job.

projects.title: Astonishers Web Reader
projects.description:
Programming by Keith Jackson, design and graphics by Chel Traynor
-Mobile and desktop-friendly experience
-Fetches all content dynamically from existing comic blog using Tumblr API
-Generates user-friendly chapter/page navigation system using Tumblr post tags
-Uses local cookies to remember user's place in the comic
